rationale.agent-scope-drift: Detects generated code departing from intended specifications while self-certifying.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Executed adversarial counter-tests deterministically expose hidden specification violations.
rationale.ai-review: Independent agents generate counter-tests; an LLM meta-judge evaluates execution evidence.
rationale.quality-debt: Empirically documents non-security correctness failures in LLM-generated code.
rationale.framework: Reusable zero-trust architecture separates generation, adversarial testing, and evidence judging.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented ZTARE and ran hundreds of adversarial evaluations.
rationale.agentic: Models autonomously produce complete code-backed theses through iterative workflows.
rationale.risk-quality: Quality: reports empirical specification-correctness failures in generated code.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled mutator and judge conditions compare models across replicated domains.
